name: condere-queue
question: When does it pay to split the Condere assessment worker into a preparation stage and a queued finalizer?
workload: A Condere assessment attempt starts once and produces one handoff to finalization in the split design. Bursts can occur while an analyst batch is submitted.
cost_scope: USD of Google Cloud Run Jobs in us-central1 at 2 vCPU and 2 GiB per worker, plus modeled durable queue fees. Compute uses default on-demand marginal rates after the shared billing-account allowance is exhausted and assumes no discounts. Excludes shared databases, model inference, storage, network, reviewer labor and migration. Reopen if any excluded cost differs between options.

sensitivity.description: The queued finalizer bills four additional minutes per attempt

evidence.confidence_rationale: Retries, coordination or longer processing raise finalization to eleven minutes. Preparation remains four minutes.

conditions.latency: Compare admission-to-result p95 and oldest queued job during a comparable burst. Set an analyst-approved completion deadline and include cold starts and time to drain.
conditions.retries: Count retries and handoffs per original attempt. Use capped retries, backoff, a dead-letter queue and an owner for safe replay before crediting the split with savings.
conditions.confidentiality: Enqueue an opaque assessment reference. Encrypt the payload and queue, restrict tenant reads and bound trace retention for private deal evidence.
conditions.integrity: Bind each reference to tenant, assessment and immutable input revision. Use an idempotent result write keyed by attempt, and acknowledge only after durable completion.
conditions.availability: Validate assumed dispatch and worker quotas under simultaneous arrivals. Track age and backlog, alert on stuck work and rehearse recovery of acknowledged and unacknowledged jobs.
conditions.least_privilege: Give the preparer enqueue-only access. Grant the finalizer dequeue and narrowly scoped result-write access. Restrict dead-letter replay to a separate operator.
conditions.source: Synthetic Condere assessment architecture planning exercise. Confirm each control with the workload owner and an independently observed burst before rollout.
